description: This file defines the 'Angle' class which provides methods for converting between degrees and radians, utilizing the built-in PHP functions rad2deg and deg2rad, with added validation and array support.

classes.name: Angle
classes.description: Provides static methods for angle conversions between degrees and radians.

methods.name: toDegrees
methods.description: Converts a numeric value or array of values from radians to degrees, with validation.

methods.name: toRadians
methods.description: Converts a numeric value or array of values from degrees to radians, with validation.
